angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 341,589 km at 37.52 pc = 0.12 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 26.6547 +/- 0.0223 mas (same row, RUWE 1.47): 37.52 pc, no zero-point correction; the RUWE is high, so the astrometry fits a single star poorly, and the parallax is used as published
radiusSource: Radius 0.491 +/- 0.015 solar radii from Crossfield et al. 2025, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-1467 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....169...89C/abstract): 341,589 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.489 +/- 0.02 solar masses from Crossfield et al. 2025, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-1467 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....169...89C/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 3834 +/- 157 K from Crossfield et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1467 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....169...89C/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Crossfield et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1467 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....169...89C/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-1467.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.745, rounded to two decimals
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1467 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.062 dex, from Polanski et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024ApJS..272...32P/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1467 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -1.42022, from Polanski et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024ApJS..272...32P/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1467 (pscomppars): age 7.2 Gyr, from Mistry et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024PASA...41...30M/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
